scope: Newly added GitHub Reviewed records only; existing modified records are audited separately. Seven supported ecosystems: npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems.
methodology: Read public maintainer repository advisory APIs linked directly by each pinned Reviewed record. Publication retains allowlisted public-advisory field projections and HTTP status/date/content-type/etag/last-modified header projections. Full descriptions and unrelated API metadata are omitted from those artifacts. Original fetched-response digests/byte counts are recorded separately from projection artifact hashes; retained projections are not exact raw responses.

Compared primary description prose and structured package names, affected strings, patched strings, severity labels, CVSS vectors/numeric values, publication/update timestamps and withdrawal state against the exact pinned database Git blobs.
Reviewed MODERATE and maintainer medium are vocabulary for the same severity band; all raw label strings remain unchanged in this audit.
Pinned OSV records generally provide CVSS vectors rather than numeric scores. Numeric maintainer values remain explicitly attributed to the API; no score was computed, rounded or invented.

Go module/pseudo-version forms, product release forms, inclusive bounds and free text are recorded literally. A matching commit suffix is evidence of a referenced commit, not an inferred universal tag-equivalence or version-order rule.

Maintainer first publication/update and database first publication/update are distinct timelines, not automatically conflicting claims. Null withdrawal means the source currently reports no withdrawal, not independent proof of continuing applicability.
limitations: No vulnerability scanning, exploit or proof-of-concept execution. Reading public proof-of-concept text does not establish exploitation in the wild.
No independent CISA KEV or exploitation verification was performed; unknown statuses remain unknown.
No additional release/tag API checks were performed. Where maintainer patch fields are empty or prose is stale, Reviewed fix values and source uncertainty remain separately attributed.
Current APIs were obtained on 2026-10-15 UTC for the 2026-10-16 update. Exact retrieval timestamps and source timestamps are preserved separately.
No GitHub rate-limit failure occurred in this 57-record scope. Previously recorded attempts outside this scope were not overwritten.

Full fetched maintainer API bodies and response headers are not published. Review observations and description digests record the prior substantive description review; the public advisory artifacts retain only allowlisted structured advisory fields and summary.
